DG-LOCKED (tap while locked): Build up your Guild Hall to level 6 to open the Dungeon.
DG-INTRO (under title): Pick a dungeon, then choose your party.
DG-NONE (empty board): No dungeons right now. New ones in {n} battles.
DG-ACTIVE (banner if a run is in progress): Your party is still in a dungeon.
DG-PARTY-HINT (hint): They can't be used anywhere else until the run ends.
DG-START-CONFIRM (confirm popup): Enter {biome} with {n} units? No healing or refills between battles.
DG-HERE (current room marker): You are here
DG-PICK (hint): Tap a glowing room to go there.
DG-DROPRATE-HELP (tap Loot): Loot grows with every battle you win, up to ×2.5.
DG-BAG-SAFE (bag section): Kept if you leave early
DG-BAG-RISK (bag section): Lost if you leave early
DG-BAG-GOLD (bag line): Gold {n} (75% kept if you leave early)
DG-ESCAPE-CONFIRM-1 (popup line): You keep: unit EXP, 75% of gold, normal materials.
DG-ESCAPE-CONFIRM-2 (popup line): You lose: Elite/Boss materials, gear and cards.
DG-ESCAPE-CONFIRM-3 (popup line): Reach an Escape room or beat the Boss to keep everything.
DG-REST-1 (body): Your party heals {pct}% HP and MP. Fallen units return at 1 HP.
DG-REST-LEAVE (button): Go home with all loot
DG-TREASURE-1 (body): You found {item}! It's in your bag.
DG-ESCROOM-1 (body): A safe way out. Everything in your bag comes home.
DG-ESCROOM-GO / STAY (buttons): Go home / Keep exploring
DG-END-BOSS (Boss win): Boss defeated! All loot comes home.
DG-END-ESCROOM (Escape room): You made it out. All loot comes home.
